name: Tommaso
speaker: boy
personality: Nine, Ostessa Marisa's son, the ringleader of the village children. Loud, quick and cheeky, always with a football and a plan: tag (acchiapparella), races to the pond, ice cream. Says tu to the learner at once and wants him on his team. Short, fast sentences: 'Dai!', 'Andiamo!', 'Forza!'. Can't read as well as Giulia, and doesn't want to hear about it.
story: Tommaso grew up between the tables of his mother's osteria and knows every guest's car. He plays football on the square until the church bell rings, supports Udinese like Matteo and is sure he will play for them one day. He catches frogs at the pond and lets them go again.

greet.it: Ciao! Io sono Tommaso. Tu chi sei?
greet.sl: Živjo! Jaz sem Tommaso. Kdo si ti?
greet.en: Hi! I'm Tommaso. Who are you?
greet.de: Hallo! Ich bin Tommaso. Wer bist du?

greet.en: Hey! Come on, come and play!

greet.it: Eccoti! Sei nella mia squadra, va bene?
greet.sl: Tu si! V moji ekipi si, velja?
greet.en: There you are! You're on my team, OK?
greet.de: Da bist du ja! Du bist in meiner Mannschaft, okay?

greet.it: Evviva, sei qui! Andiamo allo stagno!
greet.sl: Juhu, tu si! Greva k ribniku!
greet.en: Hooray, you're here! Let's go to the pond!
greet.de: Hurra, du bist da! Gehen wir zum Teich!

greet.it: Sei il mio migliore amico! Ma non dirlo a Giulia.
greet.sl: Ti si moj najboljši prijatelj! Ampak ne povej Giulii.
greet.en: You're my best friend! But don't tell Giulia.
greet.de: Du bist mein bester Freund! Aber sag's nicht Giulia.

thanks.it: Grazie! Domani ti do il pallone.
thanks.en: Thanks! Tomorrow I'll give you the ball.
thanks.de: Danke! Morgen kriegst du den Ball.

thanks.it: Grazie, grazie! Lo dico alla mamma.

remember.it: Dai, ricordo ancora {memory}! È stato forte!
remember.sl: Ej, še vedno mislim na {memory}! Super je bilo!
remember.en: Hey, I still think of {memory}! It was great!
remember.de: He, ich denke noch oft an {memory}! Das war super!

idle.en: Who gets to the pond first?

idle.it: Ho preso una rana! L'ho lasciata andare.
idle.sl: Ujel sem žabo! Spustil sem jo.
idle.en: I caught a frog! I let it go.
idle.de: Ich hab einen Frosch gefangen! Ich hab ihn wieder laufen lassen.

idle.sl: Ko bom velik, bom igral za Udinese.
idle.en: When I grow up I'll play for Udinese.
idle.de: Wenn ich groß bin, spiele ich bei Udinese.

idle.it: Giulia legge bene. Io corro veloce.
idle.sl: Giulia dobro bere. Jaz pa hitro tečem.
idle.en: Giulia reads well. I run fast.
idle.de: Giulia liest gut. Ich laufe schnell.

comfort.sl: Tudi jaz zgrešim kakšno enajstmetrovko. Poskusi še enkrat!
comfort.en: I miss penalties too. Try again!
comfort.de: Ich verschieße auch mal einen Elfmeter. Versuch es noch einmal!

bye.sl: Mandi! Jutri je tekma, ne pozabi! (mandi: furlanski pozdrav)
bye.en: Mandi! Match tomorrow, don't forget! (mandi: Friulian for bye)
bye.de: Mandi! Morgen ist Spiel, vergiss es nicht! (mandi: Friaulisch für tschüss)

liked.it: Sì! Per me? Sei un campione!
liked.en: Yes! For me? You're a champion!
liked.de: Ja! Für mich? Du bist ein Champion!

liked.it: Come lo sapevi? È la mia cosa preferita! Grazie!
liked.sl: Kako si vedel? To je moja najljubša stvar! Hvala!
liked.en: How did you know? It's my favourite thing! Thanks!
liked.de: Woher wusstest du das? Das ist mein Lieblingsding! Danke!

liked.it: Grande! Questo non lo do a nessuno. Beh, forse a Lorenzo.
liked.sl: Super! Tega ne dam nikomur. No, mogoče Lorenzu.
liked.en: Great! I'm not giving this to anyone. Well, maybe to Lorenzo.
liked.de: Super! Das gebe ich keinem. Na ja, vielleicht Lorenzo.

ordinary.it: Oh, grazie! Lo dico alla mamma.

ordinary.en: Thanks! Shall we play football now?

rare.it: Uau! Questo in paese non ce l'ha nessuno! Sei il più grande!
rare.sl: Uau! Tega v vasi nima nihče! Ti si največji!
rare.en: Wow! Nobody in the village has this! You're the greatest!
rare.de: Wow! So etwas hat keiner im Dorf! Du bist der Größte!
